 Order

The present Contempt Petition has been filed for the alleged willful disobedience of the order dated 9th May, 2022 passed by this Court in W.P.(C) No.11608 of 2022, whereby the Director (R &
R) & Ex-Officio, Addl. Secretary to Government, Department of Water Resources, Odisha,
Bhubaneswar was directed to take a decision on the letter dated 18th October, 2021 of the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Lower Indra Irrigation Project, Khariar in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of receipt of the certified copy of the order.
// 2

At the time of hearing, Mr. Mohanty, learned Additional Standing Counsel states that the award of enhanced compensation to the petitioner under Section 28 (A) (2) of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894 (for short, "the Act, 1894) would be possible only after a due field enquiry has been conducted and finalized and for the same, three months more time have been prayed for.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
We are satisfied with the explanation offered by the contemnor/opposite party in delaying the issue of entitlement of enhanced compensation to the petitioner under Section 28 (A) (2) of the Act,
1894 for his acquired land and thereafter proceed to dispose of the present Contempt Petition with the direction to the Authorities concerned to finalize the claim, one way or the other within next four months from today.
Ordered accordingly.
However, liberty is granted to the petitioner to seek the revival of the instant Contempt Petition, in case, the aforesaid exercise is not completed/done before 31st May, 2023.
